highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.157.0 brings Skia m157 and corrections across rasterization, glyph replay and GPU rendering.
highlights_body: The line also makes LibraryImport calling conventions explicit. Later collected fixes improve transformed shapes, displacement sampling and Vulkan synchronization; preview summaries below identify what shipped in each cut.

breaking.title: Check the Graphite Metal runtime minimum
breaking.body: Graphite Metal now requires iOS or tvOS 15 or later; macOS remains at 12. Raise deployment targets when using this backend, while continuing to honor any higher managed or framework minimum.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to m157 without changing managed wrappers or public signatures. The existing glyph-bounds guard is retained.

Fixes a convex anti-aliased path heap overflow across vertical clip gaps, coverage-mask clamping and convex-path bounds. Direct-mask Slug replay gains validation for unsupported fractional replay, deserialization and drawing.

Corrects reflected zero-length hairline caps, text-atlas sampler selection, transformed ellipse and rounded-rectangle geometry, and displacement offsets that could disagree with filter bounds. Empty Ganesh flushes no longer leave stale atlas work.

Fixes clip-key packing, wedge inflation and alpha-to-RGBx GPU readback stride. Clip recording respects render-pass capacity; a draw whose effective clip stack cannot fit a fresh pass is warned about and skipped.

Fixes render-pass pointer initialization and adds a 1 ms device-loss cleanup delay for ARM proprietary drivers >=42 and <56. Native synchronous submission accounts for fence-wait failures; GRContext.Submit stays void and asynchronous submission is unchanged.

Generated LibraryImport declarations now specify cdecl, matching DllImport and delegate paths, including HarfBuzzSharp. This addresses an ABI mismatch relevant to Windows x86; runtime confirmation of the reported stack-growth symptom remains outstanding.

preview_summaries.v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6: Release Candidate 1 corrects reflected hairline caps and text-atlas selection. It also adds a targeted device-loss cleanup delay for affected ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers.
preview_summaries.v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1: Preview 1 introduces Skia m157 with raster, glyph-replay and Graphite readback fixes, plus explicit cdecl LibraryImport metadata. Graphite Metal requires iOS or tvOS 15 or later, subject to higher framework requirements.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp's generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly specify cdecl to match the existing DllImport and delegate paths. This corrects calling-convention metadata without changing public APIs.

v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1.headline: Preview 1 introduces Skia m157 with raster, glyph-replay and Graphite readback corrections.
v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1.body: Generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly use cdecl. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.200 without changing the native HarfBuzz version. Graphite Metal requires iOS or tvOS 15 or later, in addition to any higher framework requirements.

v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6.headline: Release Candidate 1 corrects reflected hairline caps and GPU text-atlas selection.
v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6.body: It also adds a targeted device-loss cleanup delay for affected ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers. These fixes do not change managed APIs.
